text:
sam: PTAL @maria @alex — pushed a follow-up for PR #4823, addressed the RBAC edge-case comments and cleaned up the test flakiness. CI rerun queued.

alex: Thanks. Quick skim looks fine. One question: you removed a sleep in test_role_assignment — did you replace it with retry logic?

sam: yep, swapped the sleep for a small polling helper in test utils. Tiny diff snippet: 
```
- time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
+ pollUntil(func(){ return checkAssigned(role) }, pollBackoff)
```
Added a comment explaining the backoff.

deploy-bot: CI / unit-tests — passed — commit abc1234

maria: I like the polling change. Please name the `pollBackoff` const (so it's clear why 500ms) and then I'm happy to approve.

sam: done — added `const pollBackoff = 500 * time.Millisecond // balance between speed and flakiness` and pushed.

maria: :thumbsup: approved

rachael: heads up — we have a canary window at 11:00 PST today. Want me to queue this after the 11:00 slot?

sam: yes please, that works. I'll watch the rollout and have a rollback plan ready.

alex: one tiny ask — can you squash the fixup commit into the main change before merge? otherwise LGTM.

sam: squashed and force-pushed — thanks.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for pr/4823 — slot 11:00 — monitoring: https://ci.example/redwood/canaries/4823

sam: monitoring now. I'll post a quick follow-up if anything fails, otherwise merge after canary green.

(END)
